summary.en-US: Scrobbles what you play in the SiriusXM and Apple Music web players to Last.fm, including while the tab is in the background. Connect your Last.fm account once; no API key needed.

description.en-US:
Tab Scrobbler watches the SiriusXM and Apple Music web players and sends what you listen to to your Last.fm profile.

- Works while the player tab is in the background. SiriusXM's player normally stops refreshing its display when hidden; Tab Scrobbler keeps it awake.
- Apple Music tracks follow the standard Last.fm rule: half the track or four minutes, whichever comes first. Previews and live radio stations are not scrobbled.
- SiriusXM does not publish track lengths, so a song counts after 60 seconds of listening (adjustable). Promos, hashtags and phone numbers shown between songs are filtered out.
- Scrobbles queue up if Last.fm is unreachable and are sent later.
- The toolbar popup shows what each player tab is reporting and the most recent scrobbles.

Setup: install, click "Connect to Last.fm" on the settings page, approve access on Last.fm. That's all.

Known limits: SiriusXM talk and sports programmes shown as "Something - Something" will be scrobbled as if they were songs; switch scrobbling off in the popup for those. Detection depends on the SiriusXM player's markup and may need an update when the site changes.

Open source (MIT): https://github.com/NeilN1/TabScrobbler

release_notes.en-US: First public release. Scrobbles the SiriusXM and Apple Music web players to Last.fm, including while the tab is in the background.

version.approval_notes: Runs only on the Apple Music and SiriusXM web-player URLs listed in the manifest. page.js is injected in the page world ("world": "MAIN") to read the player's own state: Apple's MusicKit instance, and SiriusXM's player bar and Media Session metadata. On the SiriusXM player only, it also reports the tab as visible and runs animation-frame callbacks on a timer while the tab is hidden, because the SiriusXM player otherwise freezes its now-playing display in background tabs; this is the extension's core function, not tracking. The Last.fm application key in config.js is the extension's own; users authorise it through Last.fm's standard token/approve flow. Nothing is minified; the only network destination is ws.audioscrobbler.com. Source: https://github.com/NeilN1/TabScrobbler. Tests: node tests/run.js.
